# Development Workflow v5 AI adapter

Before creating a branch or ticket-linked pull request, the AI agent MUST read the target
repository's `.repository-standards.yml`, validate the complete released pairing, and load the
matching released Development Workflow v5 and Ticket Specification v3 profiles. It MUST NOT
reconstruct naming or estimation rules from memory, prompt history, an unversioned branch, or a
private alias or anchor list.

Development Workflow v5 incorporates Development Workflow v4 behavior unchanged except for its
released pairing: declaration schema v5 and Ticket Specification v3 are required. Ticket
Specification v3 is the source of ticket lifecycle, branch prefixes, and Story Point anchors.

Before a Forgejo branch write, the agent MUST validate the complete planned branch name, ticket
metadata, ticket kind, source branch, and branching model. Before a ticket-linked pull-request
write, it MUST validate title, head, target, and ticket-number correspondence. Validation MUST fail
closed and happen before the Forgejo mutation.

Regular branch forms:

- `<prefix>/<ticket-number>-<ticket-title-slug>`
- `<prefix>/<repository>-<ticket-number>-<ticket-title-slug>`

Canonical regular prefixes are generated from `profiles/ticket-specification-v3.json`:

- `Kind/Feature` -> `feature/`
- `Kind/Enhancement` -> `enhancement/`
- `Kind/Refactoring` -> `refactoring/`
- `Kind/Maintenance` -> `maintenance/`
- `Kind/Research` -> `research/`
- `Kind/Bug` -> `bugfix/`
- `Kind/Security` -> `security/`
- `Kind/Documentation` -> `documentation/`
- `Kind/Testing` -> `test/`

`fix/` is not declared and MUST be rejected. `hotfix/` is reserved for the explicit Hotfix path;
it MUST NOT be used as a generic alias for `bugfix/` or as a fallback when ticket kind is unknown.

Ticket-title slugs MUST match `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`. A repository-qualified
branch MUST name the repository that contains the ticket.

A ticket-linked pull request title MUST use
`#<ticket-number> <summary>` with a non-empty summary. Its ticket
number MUST match the ticket number encoded in the head branch. The target MUST match the selected
branching model.

When estimation is required, the agent MUST use the canonical Ticket Specification v3 estimation
model and anchors. It MUST NOT convert Story Points to time or maintain a separate estimation table.

Automated dependency pull requests without a project ticket MAY use the contract-defined exemption
when they are explicitly identified as such. Development Workflow v5 has no legacy creation-time
cutoff exemption.

A required Forgejo naming check remains defense in depth and MUST enforce semantics consistent with
the same released profiles. It does not replace this pre-write validation.
